name: Sogni AI
steps: 1 Step 1 : Read the Season 12 rules on the leaderboard Open the Sogni leaderboard and read the staking board and the T&Cs it links. That page states the 8,000,000 SOGNI pool and the 9 November cutoff.
2 Step 2 : Get SOGNI Staking uses SOGNI, an ERC-20 token on Base. The assets page describes what the token is used for, and the dashboard is where Sogni's pricing page sends people who want it.

3 Step 3 : Stake SOGNI on the dashboard Stake at dashboard.sogni.ai before new stakes close on 9 November at 00:00 UTC. If you already stake with auto-restake on, the leaderboard page says you are already in.
4 Step 4 : Check your Staking Power on the staking board Return to the staking board to see Staking Power rankings. Your portion of the airdrop follows your share of that pool.
what: The Sogni AI airdrop is its Season 12 leaderboard campaign, which sends all 8,000,000 SOGNI to people who stake the token.
